metadata.description: Cesar's personal Claude Code plugin marketplace

plugins.name: herdr-fleet
plugins.description: Hands-off orchestration on Herdr: Claude workers in Herdr panes, a file-based brief/report completion contract, fresh-context validation, risk-triaged escalation. Loads its roster from a herdr-fleet checkout.

plugins.name: superpowers
plugins.description: Core skills library for Claude Code: TDD, debugging, collaboration patterns, and proven techniques.

plugins.name: review-hats
plugins.description: Multi-perspective code review with specialized AI agents inspired by Thinking Hats.

plugins.name: gh-dashboard
plugins.description: GitHub project status dashboard for Claude Code.

plugins.name: crucible
plugins.description: Convene a panel of well-researched thinking systems to pressure-test an idea and produce a structured artifact.

plugins.name: one-page-design
plugins.description: Turns any design into a Stone Librande-style one-page document: one printable HTML surface, a depiction in the middle, the words hung off it. Ships a visual grammar, a drawing kit, an illustrator brief and a fit-check script.
